title: A worker's gate question states only figures it measured, with the command beside each
goal: A gate a worker records names each figure with the command that measured it, and the worker role file says so; SP-kuhlsf2s's BG-i7q4cjpb gate g2 said '13 more picks' while the worker's own measurement was about 10

run:
import sys
ws=['gate', 'figure', 'measured']
t=open('agents/worker.md',encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines()

print(ok)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
